# Taaroa: the stories first, then the spelling

Before the spelling, the story. **Taaroa** earns its restoration the old way — through what was actually told.

## The Stories That Carry the Name

**Origins.** Taaroa appears in polynesian tradition as creator, supreme being.  The name's meaning, "The distant one", shapes the narratives told about this figure.

**Worship and Memory.** Devotees and later tradition-keepers preserved Taaroa in ritual, text, and iconography, ensuring the name survived into the modern scholarly record.

## And Here Is What the Spelling Preserves

## The Address It Earned

The temple of **Taaroa** stands at [/taaroa/](/taaroa/) — [lore](/taaroa/lore/), [scholars](/taaroa/scholars/), [patterns](/taaroa/patterns/) — because a name carrying this much story deserves more than a parking page. One decisive feature survives — a single, honest mark — which places the restoration in Tier-2: exact, and exactly labeled.

## The Sources Are Open

The myths above are retold from the temple's record; the primary voices are in the [Sacred Texts](/texts/): [Kumulipo](/texts/kumulipo/) and [Polynesian Mythology](/texts/polynesian-mythology/). Nothing in this file outranks them.

## The Emblems

The name does not travel alone. **Name** — The restored form Taaroa, carrying scholarly and cultural weight.; **Domain** — Creator, Supreme Being. Each emblem is filed in the temple's record with its own provenance, the same discipline the spelling gets.

## For the Voice

Say "taaroa" with the stress and length implied by the scholarly restoration "Taaroa". The reconstructed line runs `/taaroa/` — the temple's pronunciation atlas carries the phonemes one by one.

## The Discipline It Answers To

This restoration belongs to Polynesian, a tradition that navigated by names the way it navigated by stars. The rules that govern it are not house style; they are the tradition's own scholarship, applied with the same care here as in any edition — and published, with the sources, so the file can be checked the way an edition can be checked. One decisive feature survives — a single, honest mark — which places the restoration in Tier-2: exact, and exactly labeled.
